script:
INT. QUIET OFFICE - DAY

One continuous five-second shot. Ava sits at a desk beside a vintage corded telephone. There is exactly one telephone base, one cradle, one handset, and one cord permanently attached at both the handset and base ends. The telephone base stays on the desk throughout. Ava's appearance and clothing remain unchanged.

At 0 seconds the telephone rings; the handset rests in the cradle and both hands are free. At 1 second Ava reaches toward the handset with her right hand. At 2 seconds her right hand grips and lifts the handset clear of the now-empty cradle. At 4 seconds the same handset is held in her right hand against her right ear; the cord remains attached to the stationary base.

AVA: "Hello?"
